media.alt_text: Richard: I am texting you to give you a personal note of thanks for signing the PACT Act in August of 2022. I served in the military from September 1986 through December 2009. Served in Iraq in 2004. Was exposed to the burn pits. Was diagnosed with Stage Four colon cancer in October 2023. Been doing very well with chemo since then. Because of the PACT Act, I was able to receive 100% disability through the VA and receive the care and treatment and financial assistance I needed to get better. The PACT Act practically saved my life and I am truly grateful to you and Congress for signing the PACT Act for all of our service members and their families. Again, thank you from the bottom of my heart.

Ken: Dear Mr. President, Thank you for visiting New Hampshire, you were right around the corner. The PACT Act is one of the best things that has helped veterans in a long time. Keep up the support for veterans! Thank you!!!
